thread:
elena park: flagged a tone-from-usability session  two UX items in the Private setup wizard networking step that popped up repeatedly: (A) probe timeline is too verbose by default for returning infra engineers; it pushes the primary form off-screen on narrow viewports, and (B) when you expand a probe detail the tab order appears to reflow so keyboard users keep landing inside the drawer (focus never returns to the Run controls). thoughts on a compact-first layout + an "advanced details" toggle?
sasha chen: agree on compact-first. idea: collapse probe timeline into a single line summary per probe (icon + short label + status pill) with a "View details" chevron. default is compact; power users can flip a "Show full logs" toggle which reveals streaming log lines. this keeps the primary inputs visible.
maia nguyen: love that. microcopy for the toggle: "Show full probe logs (advanced)". also propose wording for the compact state row: "DB reachability d OK d 42ms"  short and scannable. tooltip on the status pill: "Click to see full probe output and suggested fixes."
jamal taylor: on the a11y front the drawer must not create a modal trap unless it actually blocks interaction. Current behavior makes it modal-like. Implementation: when opening details, set focus on the drawer header and add aria-controls/aria-expanded on the opener; on close restore focus to the opener. capture like: 

const opener = document.activeElement;
openDrawer();
// after logs stream or user closes
opener?.focus?.();

Also add aria-live="polite" to the compact status so SR users get updates without focus changes.
andrew liu: small CSS/layout notes: make the compact row height 40px, left-align labels, right-align action chevron and Run button stays pinned below the list. For small screens hide the long timestamp and hide avatars. Also add a "Copy logs" icon button inside details to make it easier to paste during support calls.
elena park: good. maia, can you draft the microcopy for the status tooltip + the advanced toggle help text? jamal, confirm whether aria-live polite on compact is enough or we need assertive for failures.
maia nguyen: drafts: toggle help text: "Show full probe logs (for debugging). Enable if you need verbose output; may lengthen the step." status tooltip: "Passed (42ms). Click to open detailed log and repair suggestions." compact row label: "DNS resolution d OKd 120ms".
jamal taylor: polite for streaming/progress is fine, but if a probe fails hard we should surface an assertive notification (role="alert") so assistive tech catches it immediately. So: aria-live="polite" for incremental line updates + role="alert" toast on final failure/success. Also ensure the toggle has aria-pressed or is a checkbox with aria-checked.
design-bot: uploaded mock: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/compact-probes-202606.png :mag: shows compact rows + advanced toggle at top-right.
andrew liu: UX addendum: keyboard flow must be: Tab -> Run all probes -> first compact row -> chevron to expand -> Esc to close -> focus returns to that compact row. add an e2e keyboard test for that sequence.
elena park: action items: maia updates labels/tooltips + writes the microcopy variants, jamal implements focus restore + aria-live + final alert + ensure toggle semantics, and andrew adjusts layout/padding + adds Copy logs button. sasha will add an e2e keyboard test covering open/close/restore and compact mode. target: include in next patch. thanks all :thumbsup:
